title: Beach Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked between the refined charm of Alys Beach and the laid-back spirit of Seacrest, Beach Retreat is a modern, coastal haven designed for effortless comfort and rejuvenation. This two-story stilted home features four spacious bedrooms, each with a private ensuite, accommodating up to 12 guests with ease. Light-filled interiors flow seamlessly into large, covered porches and a private balcony off the primary suite, offering serene Gulf views. With central A/C, smart TVs in every room, and a fully equipped kitchen, it’s the perfect setting for long, lazy mornings and slow, laughter-filled evenings. Just steps from exclusive neighborhood beach access, Beach Retreat encourages barefoot adventures along 30A’s most scenic paths. Guests can unwind under the stars with a backyard BBQ, rinse off in the outdoor shower after a sun-soaked day, or head out for a stroll to nearby boutique shops and cafés. From thoughtful extras like beach gear and a walk-in pantry to its seamless blend of style and function, this home invites you to disconnect from the noise and reconnect with what matters most, sun, sand, and shared moments in a truly tranquil setting.
